DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_LilyQueen_Dark:
When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals and revives any fainted pals.
Converts own attacks to dark damage, increases dark damage by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>, and grants self a lifesteal effect that restores <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue3}%</> of damage dealt as Health.
